summary: ansible-core 2.20 removed PowerShell code that stripped quotes from paths during Windows copy and fetch operations.
questions: Why does fetch from Windows fail with quotes in the path after upgrading to Ansible 13?

answer_card.title: PowerShell path quote stripping removed
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.20 removed the PowerShell code that tried to remove quotes from paths during Windows operations like copying and fetching files. Normal playbooks are unaffected unless a value is quoted too many times.
